challenges.argument: A few-pixel error in drawing packing_entry is plausible, so shifting it 1% lower tests whether the frame-49 crossing was triggered early and cut off dwell that would otherwise reach 1500 ms.
The rule applies to the car as a whole, so using bottom_center instead of center could mislocate the car relative to inspection and packing_entry.
The rule does not define the pixel threshold for stopped, so doubling it tests whether box jitter or idle vibration wrongly prevented 1500 ms of stillness in inspection from counting.
With 100 ms frame steps an exact 1500 ms cutoff has no measurement tolerance, so testing a 20% shorter requirement checks whether this is a borderline timing case.
